biocontainers.summary: Combines wgcna and xcell readouts with bayesian network learrning to generate a gene-module immune-cell network (gmic)

biotools.summary: This package uses bayesian network learning to detect relationships between Gene Modules detected by WGCNA and immune cell signatures defined by xCell. It is a hypothesis generating tool.
